source.title: Measured S9-11.85 TH example with APW3-12-1600-B2 supply
notes: Publisher reports its own S9 bench observations. Preserved HTML and eight original images total less than1MiB. The page date and photographed operating dates are separate.
The article names APW3-12-1600-B2. The images show wall-plug power and temperature displays; they do not prove exact controller, hashboard, fan or PSU PCB revisions.
Image12 shows1317.8W and image15 shows1362.4W; article text rounds these to1317W and1362W. No stated meter accuracy or calibration certificate.
Image11 pool chart shows a2016-09-10 tooltip although the HTML page date is2019. No selected2022 firmware execution or compatibility is established.
Physical reference lead only. No simulator power/thermal calibration or G7/G8 gate passes from this record.

inspection: Original images viewed directly with view_image. No image enhancement or undocumented OCR inference.

observations.result: Exterior S9 and supplied document; exact component revisions unreadable.
Pool chart shows one-day11.84TH/s and tooltip2016-09-10. This is pool telemetry, not a calibrated hash measurement.
Wall-plug meter displays1317.8W. Sticker shows63#550M. Meter model text reads TM9+; brand lettering is uncertain. Measurement uncertainty and calibration not supplied.
Miner dashboard crop shows elapsed1h12m3s, realtime12223.85GH/s, average12228.18GH/s. Exact firmware hash absent.
Wall-plug meter displays1362.4W; same exterior label/sticker. No transient capture.
Infrared instrument displays36.3C at the chassis. Emissivity, calibration and target position not established.
Contact display reads32.8C. Publisher identifies inlet, but probe placement and uncertainty are not measured here.
Contact display reads44.9C. Publisher identifies outlet, but probe placement and uncertainty are not measured here.

limits: No exact selected controller, RAM, storage, ordered hashboard, PSU PCB or cooling revisions.
No selected2022 firmware hash, clock waveform, error bounds, load-step waveform or matched timing traces.
Wall-plug AC input includes the power supply. It cannot directly specify ASIC DC power or a thermal transfer function.
Noise text is malformed and is not normalized into a measurement.
Reference observations do not close exact-target calibration gates.
next_action: Find original revision labels and uncertainty-bearing measured reference data; keep these observations distinct from simulator calibration.
